outcome: transfusion of blood products due to PPH
invasive procedures to manage severe PPH
cohort: The cohort consisted of 96,313 women who gave birth after week 22 at Oslo University Hospital between 2008 and 2017.
finding: The study found a significant increasing trend of severe PPH and related blood transfusions during the 10-year study period, which is suspected to be partly due to increased awareness and improved registration.
